hero.title: Hake
hero.subtitle: I build beautiful, immersive digital experiences at the intersection of engineering and art.

about.bio: I'm a software engineer and creative developer with 6+ years of experience building immersive digital products. I believe software should feel as good as it looks — merging technical precision with artistic vision to create experiences that resonate. When I'm not pushing pixels, you'll find me composing chiptune music or exploring the wilderness with my camera.

projects.title: Nebula OS
projects.description: A pixel-art-inspired browser-based operating system simulator with draggable windows, a functional file system, and retro terminal — all running in pure TypeScript.
projects.longDescription: Built from scratch without any OS framework, Nebula OS simulates a complete desktop environment in the browser. Features include a virtual file system, draggable/resizable windows, a pixel-art icon set, and an interactive terminal with 30+ commands.

projects.title: Aurora UI
projects.description: A design system library with 80+ hand-crafted components featuring aurora-inspired gradient animations, dark mode first, and full a11y compliance.
projects.longDescription: Aurora UI is a production-ready React component library with a distinctive aurora borealis aesthetic. Every component is built with accessibility-first principles, comprehensive Storybook documentation, and a zero-configuration dark mode.

projects.title: Echo Analytics
projects.description: Real-time user analytics dashboard with WebSocket live updates, interactive data visualizations, and AI-powered insight summaries.
projects.longDescription: Echo Analytics processes millions of events daily and presents them through a clean, responsive dashboard. The AI layer uses LLM-powered natural language summaries to make data accessible to non-technical stakeholders.

projects.title: PixelCraft Editor
projects.description: A browser-based pixel art editor with layer support, animation frames, palette management, and one-click sprite sheet export.
projects.longDescription: PixelCraft is a full-featured pixel art creation tool built entirely in the browser. It supports multi-layer editing, frame-by-frame animation preview, custom palettes, and exports to PNG, GIF, and sprite sheet formats.

projects.title: Soundscape
projects.description: A procedural ambient music generator using the Web Audio API — create infinite, unique soundscapes with a drag-and-drop node editor.
projects.longDescription: Soundscape uses a visual node-based editor where users connect audio synthesis nodes to build complex generative music systems. Every session creates a unique, non-repeating ambient soundscape.

projects.title: Terrain Generator
projects.description: GPU-accelerated procedural terrain generation with real-time WebGL rendering, biome simulation, and exportable heightmaps.
projects.longDescription: Using noise algorithms and GPU shaders, this tool generates infinite, photorealistic terrain in real-time. Users can tweak dozens of parameters to control biome distribution, erosion patterns, and atmospheric effects.
